ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The main body in the figure is a benzene ring, with two ortho substituents on the benzene ring: one position is connected to an R/wildcard substituent, and the ortho position is connected to a nitrogen atom. This nitrogen atom is also connected to two oxygen atoms: the upper oxygen continues to connect to a vinyl fragment (O-C=C), and the lower oxygen is connected to an MgBr fragment (O-MgBr). The figure also has arrows indicating a transition state/electron movement. Then reasoning: The problem requires ignoring the arrows, so only encode the molecular graph into SMILES. R is represented by the wildcard *, and the ortho-substituted aryl core can be written as *c1ccccc1N; the two substituents on nitrogen are OC=C and O[Mg]Br respectively, so the whole is *c1ccccc1N(OC=C)O[Mg]Br.

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a molecular graph rather than as a mechanism: identify the benzene ring, the ortho wildcard/R substituent, the aryl–N bond, the N–O–vinyl connection, and the N–O–MgBr connection. Then apply the text instruction to ignore all arrows. Encode the ortho-substituted aryl core as `*c1ccccc1N...`, then append the two nitrogen substituents as `N(OC=C)O[Mg]Br`, yielding `*c1ccccc1N(OC=C)O[Mg]Br`.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中主体是一个苯环，苯环上有两个邻位取代基：一个位置连接 R/通配取代基，邻位连接一个氮原子。该氮原子还连接两个氧原子：上方的氧继续连接到乙烯基片段（O-C=C），下方的氧连接到 MgBr 片段（O-MgBr）。图中还有表示过渡态/电子运动的箭头。再推理：题目要求忽略箭头，因此只把分子图编码成 SMILES。R 用通配符 * 表示，邻位取代芳基核心可写为 *c1ccccc1N；氮上的两个取代基分别是 OC=C 和 O[Mg]Br，因此整体为 *c1ccccc1N(OC=C)O[Mg]Br。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the single natural route: directly transcribe the displayed molecular graph into SMILES while treating reaction/transition-state arrows as non-structural annotations. Other routes would be paraphrases of the same graph-reading process.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the drawing as an ortho-disubstituted benzene ring: one ring substituent is an R group, represented in SMILES by wildcard `*`, and the adjacent ring carbon is bonded to `N`. The nitrogen is bonded to an alkoxy/vinyloxy group `OC=C` on the right/top and to an `O[Mg]Br` group below/right. Curved arrows in the image are present but are not bonds.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question wording to know the required output is a SMILES string for the transition-state structure and that arrows should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: aromatic benzene is encoded with lowercase `c1ccccc1`; an unspecified R group can be encoded as wildcard `*`; substituents attached to nitrogen can be written as branches/continuations such as `N(OC=C)O[Mg]Br`; bracket magnesium as `[Mg]`; preserve connectivity but ignore curved electron-flow arrows.
